subject: legend in geom_tile plot with black lines

messages.author: 6dca3f7c22834c15
messages.subject: legend in geom_tile plot with black lines
parts:
Hi all,

I'm to this to make a tile plot with black lines "separating" the
different cells

p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(x=factor(cyl),y=gear))
p = p + geom_tile(aes(fill=factor(carb)),colour = 'black')
p = p + opts(legend.background = theme_rect())
print(p)

The plot is ok, but I was wondering if there is some way to modify the
legend in order to remove the black lines crossing the differend
legend items.

Thanks in advance for the help,

lorenzo

messages.author: 66a7bbbceef834e9
messages.subject: Re: legend in geom_tile plot with black lines
parts:
Hi Lorenzo, the trick I belive is to make to geoms, one that has a legend and another one that doesn't. The ploting order maters. So you want the "legend" geom under the ploting geom. It kind of ugly but it works.


2011/2/10 lbusett <lbu...@gmail.com>

Hi all,

   I'm to this to make a tile plot with black lines "separating" the
different cells

p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(x=factor(cyl),y=gear))

p = p + geom_tile(aes(fill=factor(carb))) + 
 geom_tile(aes(fill=factor(carb)),colour = 'black' , legend = FALSE)

p = p + opts(legend.background = theme_rect())
print(p)

The plot is ok, but I was wondering if there is some way to modify the
legend in order to remove the black lines crossing the differend
legend items.

Thanks in advance for the help,

lorenzo
